free_tier.stated: Kiwi Go at NZD 8.00/month: 2 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB storage, 1 TB bandwidth at full speed then unlimited at 2 Mbit/s, 100 Mbit/s port, Wellington New Zealand, free IPv4 and a free /64 IPv6 subnet. Kiwi Run is NZD 15.00 with 4 vCPU, 2 GB, 40 GB, 2 TB and a 200 Mbit/s port.

egress.terms: 1 TB included at the plan's port speed; past that the link continues at 2 Mbit/s with no overage charge, so a long transfer is slowed rather than billed

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed

chaining: the endless 2 Mbit/s tail after 1 TB means a slow archive sync can run all month without a bill, which no other host offers
